root_cause.text: The ndisc_ra_useropt function allocates a nduseroptmsg struct on the stack and does not initialize its padding fields (nduseropt_pad1, nduseropt_pad2, nduseropt_pad3) before copying the entire struct into a netlink message, leaking uninitialized kernel stack memory to userspace.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit zeroing of `ndmsg->nduseropt_pad1`, `ndmsg->nduseropt_pad2`, and `ndmsg->nduseropt_pad3` after setting the other fields, with the CVE stating "three padding fields that are never zeroed and can leak kernel data".
